name: Lian Jenkins
original_name: ライアン・ジェンキンス
source: Ryan is the president of Jacklost, the mayor’s son, and a master inventor.  He's proud, idealistic and cares a lot about the citizens of NYC.  He lost his legs in an accident years ago and has never forgiven Vaneast for their involvement.
